item: Check a file (bundle, custody log, image metadata) and server IPs in the source trail (Lane M)
summary: Four server checks that had no button now have one. Evidence & custody tab: one compact Check a file picker verifies a signed evidence bundle (optionally against the signer's key), a custody log export, or shows an image's EXIF, date, camera and decimal GPS; nothing leaves the machine or is stored. Sources tab: the source trail lists the server IPs a source answered from, counts the ones it could not have (Tor/proxy, not captured), shows the CDN caveat and the DB-IP credit. Feature ceiling 76 to 72.
